title: NEW MSFS 2024 Activities! Epic Landings Vol. 2 & QantasLink 12 Legs
description:
The weekly Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace update is here, and this time we are diving deep into two major milestone activity packs from Perfect Flight built to take your commercial pilot career to the next level in MSFS 2024.

First up, we are tackling a massive airline itinerary with the "12LEGS – QantasLink Spring 2026" pack. Designed natively around the default MSFS 2024 Airbus A320 V2 in the iconic QantasLink livery, these 12 ultra-realistic IFR missions mirror real-world regional routing, scheduling, and protocols out of Perth (YPPH). From busy domestic networks and resource corridors to northern regional flights, your cockpit skills will be tested using authentic aviation sounds and a dedicated custom mini-browser.

But if you’d rather trade standard airline routes for raw stick-and-rudder precision, we are heading across the globe for the "Advanced Challenges – Epic Landings Vol. 2" pack. This bundle features 24 grueling landing challenges spread across 12 countries and 3 distinct geographic zones, including the Caribbean island arc, the Amazon basin, the South American Atlantic coast, and the Andian Cordillera. You will face diverse airfields piloting 7 carefully chosen aircraft—ranging from nimble bush planes like the XCub up to heavy commercial giants like the Boeing 747-8 Intercontinental.

In this video, we break down exactly what you get inside these mission browsers, check out the specific aircraft classes (Bush, Regional, and Heavy), and analyze whether they are worth your hard-earned marketplace credits.

✈️ What do you think? Are you planning to pick up these official activity packs from the Marketplace, or will you stick to planning your own routes? Let me know your thoughts in the comment section below!

Don't forget to like, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
